findings.subject: menu
findings.summary: The stable `menu` contract has no `atom63 component` answer, so its tone axis (neutral/primary) is undiscoverable to builders.
findings.evidence: pnpm -s atom63 component menu -> component.not_found; packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components/menu.json maturity stable, tones [neutral, primary]; dropdown-menu CLI answer lists only itemVariants.
findings.fix: Index `menu` as a recipe subject in the CLI (or fold its tone axis and states into the dropdown-menu/context-menu/menubar answers) and document how to pick the primary tone.

findings.subject: menu
findings.summary: The contract's tone axis has no typed prop; primary tone needs a raw data-tone attribute.
findings.evidence: menu.json tones; menu.css:105-112 selects [data-tone='primary']; DropdownMenuContentProps/ContextMenuContentProps have no tone; menu.stories.tsx:28 sets data-tone by hand.
findings.fix: Add `tone?: 'neutral' | 'primary'` to DropdownMenuContent, ContextMenuContent, MenubarContent (and sub contents), mapped to data-tone, with the contract default.

findings.subject: menu
findings.summary: Menu rows are 32px tall on coarse pointers instead of the 44px row floor.
findings.evidence: Menu rows floor at --a63-control-min-size, which is 2rem (32px) on coarse pointers, not --a63-row-min-size (2.75rem on touch): packages/ui-react/src/components/menu/menu.css:59-62; packages/styles/src/contracts/environment.css:128-137 (row-min-size is the documented floor for full-width rows in clipping containers, environment.css:68-76).
findings.fix: Floor .a63-Menu-item min-height with max(..., var(--a63-row-min-size)) and add a web+touch Endpoints cell (designLanguage web, input touch) to the baselines.

findings.subject: menu
findings.summary: The submenu chevron points right in RTL, away from where the submenu opens.
findings.evidence: The submenu chevron (.a63-Menu-sub-icon) has no RTL mirror rule in packages/ui-react/src/components/menu/menu.css (breadcrumb does mirror its chevron, breadcrumb.css:63-68); no story in this batch sets dir="rtl" (grep for rtl in the batch stories: none).
findings.fix: Mirror .a63-Menu-sub-icon under :dir(rtl)/[dir='rtl'] as breadcrumb does, and add an RTL menu story with a long and a CJK label.

findings.summary: Vertical orientation is broken in the default variant: the track keeps one-row height and the sliding indicator never moves vertically.
findings.evidence: tabs.css .a63-Tabs-list[data-variant='default'] {height: var(--tabs-height)}; default indicator {top:50%; transform: translateX(var(--active-tab-left)) translateY(-50%)}; tabs.json orientations [horizontal, vertical]; docs 'Orientation is component behavior'.
findings.fix: Under [data-orientation='vertical'] set the default list height:auto and position the indicator with top:0 + translateY(var(--active-tab-top)); add a Vertical story for every variant with baselines and a test.
